title: Spirits of the past
description: Return of the Jedi, like all three films in the original Star Wars saga, had scenes or bits-of-business cut out at the last minute for various creative reasons. Luke's introduction in the first movie was smartly delayed, the wampa attack in Empire was rightly deemed excessive (the Rebels had enough to contend with), and Jedi had its share of sheared sequences. Originally, a bit existed where Darth Vader used his dark Force power to grip a subordinate by the throat, continuing the tradition started in A New Hope ("I find your lack of faith disturbing..."). But as Vader was to redeem himself at film's end, it was decided that he shouldn't do anything too monstrous this time around.
